title: Lightly Dehydrated Thai Fish Kanom Ko
description: A pescatarian-friendly Thai dish featuring lightly dehydrated fish, persian cucumber, and a bitter yet bouncy texture, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the dehydrator to 135 degrees Fahrenheit.
Place the fish balls on the dehydrator trays in a single layer.
Dehydrate the fish balls for 2 hours or until lightly dried and still bouncy.
In a large bowl, whisk together fish sauce, lime juice, palm sugar, chili flakes, and salt.
Add the sliced persian cucumber to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Once the fish balls are dehydrated, add them to the bowl and toss to combine with the cucumber and sauce.
Sprinkle the crushed dehydrated kaffir lime leaves over the top of the fish balls and cucumber.
Serve the Lightly Dehydrated Thai Fish Kanom Ko immediately, garnished with additional kaffir lime leaves if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
